news.headline: SEC to consider termination of LSU's membership at Dec. 3 meeting
news.description: For the second time this year, the SEC is threatening to hold a vote of its chancellors and presidents on whether to kick LSU out of the league, according to a filing in federal court in Alabama on Monday.

news.headline: Georgia defensive coordinator Glenn Schumann agrees to coach Florida State
news.description: Georgia's Glenn Schumann, one of the country's top defensive coordinators and part of a staff that has the Bulldogs at No. 1 in the CFP rankings, agreed to a five-year deal to become the next coach at Florida State, the school announced Monday.

news.headline: Aiden Flora, nation's leading rusher, re-signs with Iowa State for next season
news.description: Iowa State running back Aiden Flora, who leads the nation in rushing, announced Monday that he has re-signed with the Cyclones for next season.

news.headline: Texas A&M names John Thornton interim athletic director effective Dec. 1
news.description: John Thornton will take over as interim athletic director at Texas A&M, effective Dec. 1, replacing the departed Trev Alberts.

news.headline: Sources: Giants DC Dennard Wilson interviews for HC job at alma mater Maryland
news.description: Giants defensive coordinator Dennard Wilson had a virtual interview recently for the vacant head coaching job at Maryland, sources told NFL Network.

news.headline: LSU's Lane Kiffin apologizes for using profanity during halftime interview
news.description: LSU coach Lane Kiffin has apologized for using profanity during a halftime interview with the school's radio network in Saturday's loss to Tennessee.

news.headline: Wake Forest leading rusher Ty Clark ruled out for season
news.description: Wake Forest running back Ty Clark will miss the rest of the season, coach Jake Dickert announced Monday.

news.headline: Syracuse rules QB Steve Angeli (shoulder) out vs. Notre Dame
news.description: Syracuse has ruled starting quarterback Steve Angeli out for Saturday's game against Notre Dame due to a shoulder injury.

news.headline: Indiana not yet naming starting QB for game vs. Purdue, Curt Cignetti says
news.description: Indiana is not yet naming a starting quarterback for Saturday's rivalry game against Purdue, coach Curt Cignetti said Monday.

news.headline: Alabama's Kalen DeBoer expects QB Keelon Russell to be 'full go' vs. Auburn
news.description: Alabama coach Kalen DeBoer said Monday that he expects QB Keelon Russell, who is working his way back from an ankle injury, to be "full go" for rivalry week against Auburn.

wiki.title: Kade Pieper
wiki.intro: Kade Pieper (born February 18, 2005) is an American college football center for the Iowa Hawkeyes.

sections.title: Early life
sections.text: Pieper attended Norfolk Catholic High School in Norfolk, Nebraska. He played both offensive and defensive line in high school. He was district MVP as a senior after recording 130 tackles. Pieper originally committed to play college football at North Dakota State University before flipping his commitment to the University of Iowa. He also won a state title in shot put his senior year.

sections.title: College career
sections.text: Pieper played in two games and redshirted his first year at Iowa in 2023 and played in 11 games as a backup in 2024. In 2025, he entered the season as the team's starting right guard. He started all 13 games, was named third-team All-Big ten, and was part of the group who received the Joe Moore Award. Prior to the 2026 season, Pieper was named the Associated Press preseason first-team All-American at center.
